London gets much more rain than Cairo (about 25 mm a year), Riyadh and Dubai (about 100 mm each), Las Vegas (about 120 mm), Phoenix (about 200 mm), Los Angeles (about 370 mm), and Madrid (about 440 mm), against London's roughly 600 mm.
